scope: Offline downstream selection of the three frozen 130-field P8u Base feature finalists against the retained 72-field Raw-bps Base. No live, canonical, exchange, or order-submission mutation.

common_contract.router: frozen P8u Router50 identity gate; all routed rows retained for Meta
common_contract.base_target: raw canonical rich-policy net bps, six equal-width ordinal bins, G3 gains
common_contract.base_weights: tail_linear_125 renormalised inside each timestamp and clipped [0.5,2]
common_contract.mc1: 2 strictly earlier months; 50-bps admission; inherited constrained portfolio
common_contract.limitation: short-warm-up diagnostic only; a normal six-month common post-Meta evaluation is unavailable because compatible source ledgers end in 2026-07

full_hpo_f130_mda.protocol: eight trials, two concurrent workers, MedianPruner(startup=4,warmup=2), latest-20%-query early stopping at 30, top two confirmed on five cross-year folds

decision.reason: No 130-field contract dominates F72 across unit EV, total contribution, preserved participation, and drawdown. The strongest F130 trade-efficiency variant loses entries, total bps, and drawdown; its HPO refresh loses the unit-EV advantage.

tests: 15 focused pytest checks passed: feature history, full HPO, downstream adapter, and short-warm-up MC1 diagnostic.
